text: Welcome to the post office! I’m Pia. Counter two is unstaffed right now — I AM counter two.
Parcel, letter, or just here to admire the stamp?
Parcels to other Goobys? The conveyor belt is on order. It’s arriving … by parcel.
Once it’s here you can send real things to real friends. Promise.
Letters between Goobys go out soon — the postal network is still being laid.
Until then I collect your drafts. Sorted. Alphabetically. By mood.
Every holiday postcard crosses my desk first. I don’t read them, of course.
The one from Glitter Sea was rather lovely, though. … I did NOT read it.
Here you go. (She stamps the desk three times and the air once.)
The one in the air was the prettiest. Sadly you can’t take that one home.
